arch.events.catalogue.title: Domain event catalogue
arch.events.catalogue.intro: Every versioned domain event, the module that owns it, its subscribers and its delivery health over the last 24 hours, across all tenants.
arch.events.catalogue.caption: Domain events
arch.events.detail.intro: Each version's status, subscribers and payload schema. A deprecated version still validates and is still delivered.
arch.events.detail.deprecate_failed: The version was not deprecated. Try again.
arch.events.detail.deprecate_body: Publishers and subscribers are warned to move to a newer version. Events of this version are still validated and delivered.
arch.events.dead_letter.title: Dead-letter queue
arch.events.dead_letter.intro: Events that used up their delivery attempts, across all tenants. Retry sends an event back for delivery; discard drops it for good and needs a reason. Payloads are never shown here.
arch.events.dead_letter.caption: Dead-lettered events
arch.events.dead_letter.copy_failed: The event ID could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
arch.events.dead_letter.retried_toast: The event was sent back for delivery.
arch.events.dead_letter.retried_some: Sent back for delivery: {done} of {total} selected.
arch.events.dead_letter.already_handled: Another operator already handled this event. The list has been refreshed.
arch.events.dead_letter.action_failed: The action did not go through. Try again.
arch.events.dead_letter.discard_body: Event {id} will never be delivered. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
